I am humbled by the political and financial support from Texans all over the state.  Turns out there are a lot of folks who want a qualified attorney as Attorney General of Texas…


Eleanor Klibanoff (@eklib)

@mayes_middleton has given himself another $2.5 million for the runoff, campaign finance reports show.  

In a reversal from the primary, Roy has outraised Middleton during this period (even including Middleton’s self-funding) and is spending more on ads so far.



— https://nitter.net/ekl

“When it comes to defending your Second Amendment rights, there is a clear choice in the Attorney General race #2A

Roy is:

✅ Endorsed by @TXGunRights
✅ Endorsed by @gunrights
✅ Endorsed by @GunOwners
✅ “A” Rated by @NRA

Texas gun owners know who they can trust.”

Grateful for the support of Goliad Co Sheriff Roy Boyd. We stood shoulder to shoulder during the Biden Border Crisis, and I’m proud to have earned the support of Sheriffs across S Texas

Never again should S Texas endure that chaos. As AG, I’ll defend our border relentlessly.

Video

And the #1 rated America First Congressman - out of all 435 in the US House - is… Chip Roy?  But how can that be?  We’ve been reliably told by my opponent that I’m a RINO… and we know that St. Middleton cannot tell a lie…


America First Hunter (@Amer1stHunter)

Compare what Republican Congressmen SAY vs. what they DO. Congressmen may talk America First but are they actually?
